verdict.comment: With a good run under her belt and today's step up in trip, the well-related COMA CLUSTER may well get off the mark.

comments.anjobonita: Disappointing 2024; same owners but change of stable since she was last seen in September
comments.beatriceshilling: 0-9; has threatened a win and she was second of five at Wolverhampton (AW) one month ago
comments.bintabuha: Placed at Newmarket on first two starts but has not fared so well in her three races since
comments.comacluster: Close second on handicap debut at Nottingham (1m, good); it looks like she will stay 1m2f
comments.cymbidium: 1m winner and there's plenty of hope for 1m2f; improvement is needed but possible
comments.princessniyla: Competitive judged on plenty of 2024 evidence but needed first two runs in that campaign
comments.questionable: All turf runs on good or softer; reached the frame in all her seven handicaps, winning one
comments.rockcamelot: Front-runner; handicap debut should offer much better prospects of the breakthrough win
comments.shifter: Reappears on a good mark but she was well held first time out in the last two seasons
comments.starcast: Ex-Sir Mark Prescott; 100-1 in maiden on return; should stay 1m2f and needs a second look

races.raceComment: anjobonita is marginally preferred with a score of 49.1%, holding clear edges in more proven at trip and stronger recent form and superior course form over cymbidium. Won 1 of last 6 starts, though unfavorable draw and inconsistent profile need consideration.

verdict.comment: The vote goes to STRATOCRACY (nap) who travelled well for a long way at Redcar and may have just needed it after five months off.

comments.candonomore: Has failed to make the frame in all six handicaps; ground unlikely to be in his favour
comments.commanderoflife: Running well on the AW this year, but just 2-23 and well beaten in three starts on turf
comments.cosmosraj: Not seen on turf for some time, but has won six times on grass including over C&D
comments.jazzscene: 1-6 for Sir Mark Prescott last year; market useful on stable debut after nine months off
comments.jesmonddawn: Should be suited by the conditions; ran well for a long way on recent Musselburgh return
comments.oberonhill: In the frame in three small-field contests on AW this year; more needed; hood on
comments.parislights: Beaten under a length into second at Pontefract last time; shortlisted if repeating that
comments.powerofgold: 1-19, but beaten less than a length into third on return from six months off at Pontefract
comments.soamesforsyte: Acts on AW and turf, but has been beaten three times off this mark so more is needed
comments.stratocracy: Dual winner over 1m last year and third on his Redcar return; major player from same mark

races.raceComment: jesmonddawn is marginally preferred with a score of 54.1%, holding clear edges in better suited by conditions and more progressive over stratocracy. Won 1 of last 6 starts. Ground (Good To Firm) looks ideal with 2 wins from 9 starts in similar conditions. Could develop into tactical affair with no obvious pace-setter, though unfavorable draw and inconsistent profile need consideration.

verdict.comment: A case can be argued for most of these but his record fresh, allied to a lowly handicap mark, tips the scales in favour of HAIL SEZER.

comments.cubanstorm: Ties in with Glory Hyde on 2024 form but likely best watched back from 227 days off
comments.darkkestrel: Needs everything to fall right but on a lowly mark on turf and this trip could be ideal
comments.firstcompany: Infrequent turf winner but ran well when last seen and has a good record for B Loughnane
comments.gloryhyde: Promise on return and poorly drawn latest; on a winning mark; another to consider
comments.hailsezer: On a good mark, effective over C&D and has a good record fresh; plenty to like
comments.jojorabbit: On a dangerous mark and his return to action wasn't without hope; one to consider
comments.milbanke: Not beaten a rival in two runs for new stable; down in weights but plenty to prove
comments.northcliff: Good mark on 2024 best; return to turf/new visor both offer hope of an improved showing
comments.willolarupi: Won twice last year and his reappearance can be upgraded on two counts; interesting
comments.yazaman: Ended losing run last May before adding 3 more wins; encouraging return; each-way shout

races.raceComment: willolarupi is marginally preferred with a score of 44.8%, holding clear edges in better ratings and better suited by conditions and stronger recent form and superior course form over firstcompany. Won 1 of last 6 starts, though unfavorable draw and inconsistent profile and regressive form need consideration.

verdict.comment: This can go to ZAPPATA who took a big step forward when a close second on handicap/turf debut at Yarmouth on Tuesday.

comments.cudabeenarowlex: Off the mark over 1m2f at Redcar last time; should be fine over 1m on this stiffer track
comments.goldenharmony: Well held in three starts over 6f/7f; major improvement needed on handicap debut
comments.heartened: Some promise on her Pontefract debut last summer, but not built on it since
comments.helaali: Gelded and has had a wind op since last seen; interesting to see if his backers return
comments.magictopissima: Has shown ability, as when fourth on her penultimate outing, but opposable on balance
comments.mavetheforcebewivu: One standout piece of form for another yard last year, but modest otherwise
comments.pennavenue: Bred to be better than she has shown; worth monitoring in the market on handicap debut
comments.prettyspirited: Beaten a head on return/handicap debut at Southwell last time; one of the likelier winners
comments.respirosolitario: In the frame in his last two starts on AW last year, both in a tongue-tie (now missing)
comments.stormkitty: Well beaten in three starts at Newcastle; big improvement required on handicap/turf debut
comments.transfuse: Well held in three starts over 7f/1m; worth a market check now switched to a handicap
comments.westkirby: Well held in four starts for Jonathan Portman last year; watch market on stable debut
comments.zappata: Beaten under a length at Yarmouth on Tuesday; should take all the beating from same mark

races.raceComment: cudabeenarowlex is confidently preferred with a score of 40.2%, holding clear edges in more proven at trip and better suited by conditions and superior course form over zappata. verdict.comment: The vote goes to dual C&D winner HOW IMPRESSIVE who has only just missed out here the last twice and remains favourably treated.

comments.arcticdawn: 0-5; returns from 164 days off having been gelded; well worth monitoring in the market
comments.brunelnation: Back off last winning mark but needs to better his two performances since returning
comments.callianassa: Runner-up in four of her last ten starts and in the frame in another four, but now 0-26
comments.cholaempire: Three of his four wins have come over C&D but others may now be better treated
comments.driftsaway: 5-8 on AW since October; bids for a four-timer off a 3lb higher mark; serious contender
comments.feeltheneed: Won over 1m here in December; another furlong may suit ideally but he's each-way material
comments.giorgiom: Runner-up in his last three starts, the latest over C&D; should go well again
comments.howimpressive: Dual C&D winner; Oisin Murphy gets on well with him (211012); blinkers replace usual visor
comments.jimmyspeaking: 1lb above last winning mark; good third on his return over C&D this month; shortlisted
comments.kingofithaca: Record over C&D since last August reads 131215; high on the list under these conditions
comments.quandary: Placed in four visits here but disappointed at Newcastle last time; needs to bounce back
comments.tencommitments: Twice held over C&D since returning last month; behind two of these last time; needs more
comments.vinceleprince: Five wins over 7f on turf; ran well on Musselburgh return but poorly in his only AW start
comments.waytodubai: Didn't back up a promising stable debut next time and is now 0-15 in Britain

races.raceComment: kingofithaca is marginally preferred with a score of 55.6%, holding clear edges in more proven at trip and better suited by conditions over quandary. Won 2 of last 6 starts. Ground (Standard) looks ideal with 4 wins from 11 starts in similar conditions. Key attributes include optimal distance, though step up in class and unfavorable draw and inconsistent profile and regressive form need consideration.

verdict.comment: A competitive race in which NOBLE VICTORY could take a step forward from his promising handicap debut. Don Pacifico is feared most.

comments.bonniesboy: 2nd in 3 of 5 starts as 2yo; gelded during his absence; drawn wide and has a bit to prove
comments.donpacifico: C&D winner; torrid trip in good race at Newcastle on Good Friday; still unexposed
comments.fanmail: 6f win at Newcastle in February; close fourth over C&D next time; below par on turf latest
comments.hammerthehammer: Won a poor 5f maiden here last month, albeit with ease; this looks a much stiffer test
comments.handcuffed: Often highly tried at two but ran well off this mark in one nursery start; yard in form
comments.invitorio: 6f turf win at two; promising return to action when close fourth at Pontefract
comments.mrcool: Made all in 6f handicap at Nottingham 15 days ago; 5lb higher against stronger rivals
comments.mrfantastic: Absent since unplaced in York sales race last October; 1-1 on AW (7f); 6f should be fine
comments.mythicalcomposer: Ran well on last three 2yo starts but he will need more for AW if he is to defy this mark
comments.naanasdiamond: Listed win in Italy last summer; unplaced in two runs in Dubai this year; handicap debut
comments.noblevictory: Ran well for fourth on handicap debut this month; can do better granted a faster pace
comments.rarechange: 0-8 as a 2yo but the odd promising run; gelded since latest effort; can do better
comments.scatterpenny: Unplaced in four handicaps but was keeping on well at Pontefract on her return 19 days ago
comments.wheelsoffire: 5f Polytrack win as 2yo; unplaced in both his handicaps but was only 4-1 on each occasion

races.raceComment: mrcool is marginally preferred with a score of 47.2%, holding clear edges in stronger recent form and more progressive over fanmail. Won 1 of last 6 starts. Going is a significant concern - yet to win on Standard ground from 1 attempts. Strong pace likely with multiple front-runners. Key attributes include positive comments, though step up in class and unfavorable draw and inconsistent profile need consideration.

verdict.comment: Badri, Northern Spirit and DRAMA look the three to focus on. The selection still has more to offer on synthetic surfaces.

comments.badri: Conditions to suit; unlucky in running here last month; ignore latest run; major player
comments.bergerac: Big player on last year's best form; sharper for last month's return; shortlisted
comments.bosh: Useful for R Hannon; low-key stable debut but he's better than that; drawn widest
comments.drama: Big chance on last year's Kempton wins; latest turf run easy to excuse; headgear switch
comments.dutchkingdom: Form has taken off in recent starts; return to 6f could prompt another step forward
comments.manyastar: Conditions to suit but suspicion he'll prove vulnerable in this grade
comments.northernspirit: Improving sprinter; ran on strongly to score on recent return to action (5f); C&D winner
comments.princeofpillo: Beaten three times since Lingfield win in February; work to do with Westmorian on latest
comments.rohaan: On the downgrade but retains sufficient ability to play a part at this level
comments.sophiasstarlight: Of interest on her useful turf form and her reappearance was fine; down in grade here
comments.thebellconductor: Good course record; won over 6f last summer but probably vulnerable after a layoff
